name: stuck-detector
description: Notices when the same test command fails twice in a row and tells the model to ask for a second opinion.

note.title: Note to the model
note.description: Added to the result of a test command that has failed twice in a row.
note.default: This test command has failed twice in a row. Stop fixing and ask for a second opinion: brief the second-opinion and second-opinion-sonnet agents with the symptom, what you tried, what each attempt showed, and the files to read first.
